svg.text: SuffAI Command Center · Engineering Review Diagram
As deployed on Google Cloud (region asia-south1): trust boundaries, service identities, how every hop is authenticated, and the numbered end-to-end flow · reviewed 18 Oct 2026
private · V4 signed URLs for the UI
Cloud Run · FastAPI API + static web UI in one container
login · Geo · Ads Lab · Campaigns · Style · Admin · AURA panel
BigQuery login · in-memory session (12 h) · competitors masked
metrics from BigQuery (cached 120 s) · stores · market · brief
5 SKUs per chunk under a DB lease · extract → compare → rank
config · estimate · launch · monitor (Simulated) · signed images
Gemini tool calls · ui_focus sync · PII + internal IDs scrubbed
intel from BigQuery · unique garments via similarity proxy
1 vCPU · 1 GiB · allow-unauthenticated · one uvicorn process
system of record · Cloud SQL connector · DATABASE_URL
act-as cc-tasks · BigQuery jobUser + dataViewer · Vertex AI user
Storage object create/view · Cloud SQL client · Token Creator on self
run.invoker on extraction + similarity (Pub/Sub push OIDC)
run.invoker on Command Center (Cloud Tasks OIDC, audience = URL)
starts the suffai-cdc and suffai-bq-sync Cloud Run Jobs
Sign in over HTTPS: POST /v1/auth/login returns a session token, sent as X-Session-Token
Password hash checked in BigQuery login_cred_db; Geo metrics read from suffai_ops (cached 120 s)
Ads Lab SKU images written to Cloud Storage under brands/brand/campaign/
Campaign, SKU and job rows created in Cloud SQL (processing · pending · queued)
Job chunk enqueued on Cloud Tasks campaign-jobs (or run in a thread if Tasks isn't set up)
Cloud Tasks calls /internal/campaign-jobs/:id/run with an OIDC token minted as cc-tasks
Extract attributes: POST /v1/extract with a Google ID token; Gemini 2.0 Flash label card
Compare with PIN wardrobes: POST /v1/similarity/compare-pins with an ID token; top 5 per PIN
Rank (55% visual · 15% frequency · 30% attribute fit); save scores and per-customer picks
Campaigns tab: image URLs signed (V4) through the IAM Credentials API (signBlob)
Browser loads SKU images straight from Cloud Storage with the signed URLs
AURA: /v1/agent/chat with ui_focus; ownership checked, then Gemini 2.5 Flash tool calls
Geo stores and market data: Gemini 2.5 Flash + Google Search grounding, cached 7 days
Customer photos, scheduled loads and deploys (lettered)
Customer garment photo stored in Cloud Storage under garments/
Upload event published to Pub/Sub topic garment-image-uploaded
Two push subscriptions call extraction and similarity with an OIDC token (pubsub-push)
Extraction writes the label card and job state to Cloud SQL (all fields ≥ 0.90 auto-accepted)
Similarity counts each garment once per PIN in Cloud SQL and copies observations to BigQuery
Cloud Scheduler starts Cloud Run Jobs: suffai-cdc hourly, suffai-bq-sync daily at 02:15 IST
Jobs read MongoDB and load suffai_ops, staging and marts into BigQuery
Cloud Build image → Artifact Registry repo suffai → gcloud run deploy --update-env-vars
Private services accept only Google-signed tokens (ID tokens, Pub/Sub push and Cloud Tasks OIDC)
Every campaign and job read checks brand ownership; brand logins see other brands as Competitors
AURA guard strips customer PII and internal IDs before Gemini; its on-screen focus carries no IDs
Users see masked errors with a reference ID; the full error goes to Cloud Logging
The plaintext credentials CSV is kept out of the image by .dockerignore
Cloud Tasks retries a chunk up to 10 times (10–300 s backoff); a job stalled 180 s is re-dispatched
Each chunk runs under a DB lease, so a retried or duplicate task can't process the same SKUs twice
Extraction is idempotent on the Pub/Sub message ID; bad payloads are acked, other errors retried
Geo store and market lookups are cached 7 days in Cloud SQL; metrics are cached 120 s per instance
Sessions, AURA state and staged uploads live in one instance's memory. A second Cloud Run
instance signs users out at random: set --max-instances=1 now, move sessions to Cloud SQL or
Passwords are unsalted SHA-256 hashes (BigQuery login_cred_db and the CSV fallback in the
image). Move to bcrypt or argon2, or to Identity Platform.
Signed image URLs need Token Creator on the runtime account itself and
iamcredentials.googleapis.com enabled; otherwise Campaigns shows drawn placeholders.
Campaign jobs run in a thread unless setup_cloud_tasks.sh was run. Cloud Run CPU is
request-only, so those jobs mostly advance while the UI polls.
Services fall back to the default compute account, which often has Editor. Give each service
deploy_command_center.sh writes DATABASE_URL as a plain env var (prefer --set-secrets), and
CORS_ORIGINS=* is set on the public service (restrict it to its own URL).
Cloud Run Jobs: suffai-cdc and suffai-bq-sync · all images in Artifact Registry repo suffai
service call with a Google ID token or OIDC token
async: queue, push event, schedule or copy

Source: deploy/*.sh, Dockerfile.command_center, command_center/*.py, worker/, similarity/ · PROJECT stands for the GCP project ID · campaign impact metrics are simulated and labelled Simulated in the UI · brand logins see competitors masked · no customer PII is sent to the AI
